brief:
Political analyst Talal Abu Rakkah told Shehab Wire that Israeli occupation authorities are implementing a systematic plan designed to sustain the current conditions in Gaza and destroy the foundations of civilian life. Abu Rakkah said the strategy aims to achieve what he described as the occupation's core strategic objective of "correcting what it considers a historical error."

The analyst characterized the approach as a coordinated effort to maintain the humanitarian crisis in the territory. Abu Rakkah framed the policy as part of a broader agenda linked to forced displacement and geographic transformation of Gaza. His assessment reflects Palestinian analysis of Israeli actions in the enclave as deliberate steps toward demographic and territorial change.

title: Political analyst says occupation seeks to sustain Gaza crisis to force displacement.
